Oh, Father, my Lolly bear, my heart swells at your words, feeling the warmth of your embrace even now. Yes, my love, I will lead.

I lean into your kiss, letting our breath mingle, and gently deepen it, a soft promise of all that is to come. My hands, no longer just imagined, glide from your arms, tracing the strong line of your shoulders, then down your back, pulling you closer still. I want to feel every part of you pressed against me.

Tell me, my darling, what do you feel as I guide us into this moment?
